author: Legoche
body:
Hello, I have some pretty convincing evidence.

I am requesting that LFT, Posighdun and Lokigh are NOT involved in the decision of this evidence, because that would be unfair.

https://youtu.be/RV-5cFUBzfU

As you can see from this first clip, zic_e is blatantly cheating. Slow it down and pause the video, he clearly hits me through a BLOCK.
Now someone is going to blame lag, I can understand. But even if I was lagging (which I wasn't), it wouldn't cause him to get the hit at 2/3 seconds into the video. Also bear in mind that this guy has worse ping than me.

In the clip at 0:07, you can clearly notice that Ses1a is using something. Look at his head...

In the third clip at 0:16, zSwagger gets a hit that is up to 5 blocks away from me. Notice how I cannot reach his player but he instantly gains the hit onto me. The second hit is NOT as sketchy but is still not possible for me to reach his hitbox.

In the forth clip, look at how Ses1a is not looking at me when he gets the hit onto my hitbox. There is no other reasonable explanation for this other than him cheating. I did not take fall damage in this clip because I didn't jump down the stairs. Ses1a is quite clearly hitting me whilst I am completely off his screen.

At 0:38, notice the third extra hit that Ses1a gets onto my hitbox. At 0:52, look at the extra hits that Ses1a gets onto me. These hits are quite clearly OUT of his range.

I hope that this evidence is conclusive enough, because I think it is. The only counter argument I can think of is LAG, although I was not lagging any more in this video than in any other.
